name: Swiss kinetic grid typography

source.description: Genre convention: International Typographic Style posters adapted to motion; strict grid, oversized grotesk, one signal colour.

technique: Words land on a visible grid with hard cuts, mask rises and character cascades; colour marks the key word.

decomposition.timing: Hard cuts on beats; 0.3-0.5 s entrances

licensing_notes: Technique only. No specific artwork, footage, characters or compositions from any source are copied.
